name: jinchenma-ip-builder
title_zh: 正侧背三视图加角色设定档，一张照片出全套
tagline_zh: 不用会画，不用找画师。传一张清晰正脸照，拿回可携带的 IP 包：三视图 + character-spec.md。
tagline_en: No drawing skill, no artist needed. Upload one clear photo, get a portable IP pack: 3-view turnaround +.
desc_en: 从一张清晰人物照片或已有角色三视图创建、校验并保存可携带的个人 IP 包，生成统一的正面、侧面、背面三视图和 character-spec.md。适用于创建个人 IP、角色设定、三视图、character turnaround、IP pack、avatar builder、character consistency 等任务。
why_zh: 不只是出图，它把角色设定固化成结构化 spec，让后续所有生成都锚定同一份身份描述，而不是靠抽卡碰运气。
why_en: It doesn't just draw—it locks identity into a structured spec, so every later generation anchors to one source of truth instead.
limit_zh: 只吃清晰正脸照或已有三视图；侧脸/模糊/遮挡会直接报错。产物是 PNG 三视图 + Markdown 档。
limit_en: Requires a clear frontal photo or existing turnaround; profile/blurry/occluded inputs error out. Outputs PNG views + Markdown spec only—no model.
title_en: Full character turnaround + spec from one photo
